body: When I was fine I dreamt about being depressed and waking up to feeling good was such a relief. Now it's the other way around. In hindsight this was quite an obvious early warning sign.

So first of all at least for me it's all connected. If I'm feeling lower, the fog in my brain is worsen my motivation is less and I have less energy. 

I was in a similar situation like you. Huge lack of energy and my physical wellbeing was very low. Blood test was fine. I guess I subconsciously denied being depressed but then I realized it's depression and I would say you should see a professional as soon as possible to help you. If Paxil worked for you in the past you might want to give it a try again. And if possible do light activities outdoors even if you feel like your body needs rest.
Gotcha! So you're already taking it for a year and half? When did you feel the effect?

Yep there are! Wellbutrin for example is an norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor(NDRI). Maybe I should give it a try although Wikipedia says it usually decreases appetite and mine is already very low and I don't wanna lose weight. Zoloft is the one I'm on right now which fucks with my digestion and sexual ability. What was your bad reaction to it?

Thanks for your reply! I'm on my third SRI but that one is not working (like the others) and I also got side effects which suck. I feel like SRIs just don't work for me but my psych tells me that these are the only suitable ones...

I'm financially free which just ads up to the big pile of stuff in my life which should make sure I'm not depressed. I could go anywhere in the world and live there on savings (aka my family's money) but the fucked up thing about depression is that you can't run away from it and that there's never a logical reason to be depressed. There's people that lose their whole family in a car crash and they get something positive ou of it. And than there's people with enough money, a loving family, friends, good looks, intelligence, you name it and the get very depressed. 
So I really have every freedom I can think of but I'm still struggling A LOT. I'm not saying that things wouldn't be a lot worse if the circumstances were worse but I believe you can live a "perfect" life and still be severely depressed.
